headline: Greaves Cotton shares surge 11% despite sharp profit decline
hook: Revenue growth drives Greaves Cotton rally
summary: Greaves Cotton shares rose 11.6% following a 44.2% year-on-year revenue increase in the September quarter. Net profit dropped 81% to ₹5 crore, largely impacted by ₹32.75 crore in exceptional expenses. Despite the profit dip, EBITDA grew 41% to ₹74 crore, signaling operational strength. The market rally reflects investor focus on top-line growth and core operating performance over bottom-line figures.
why_it_matters: Operational growth metrics may outweigh bottom-line profit hits for shareholders.

headline: Greaves Cotton posts 44% revenue surge alongside narrowing EV losses in Q2 FY27
hook: Strong revenue growth offset by lingering EV losses
summary: Greaves Cotton reported a 44% surge in revenue for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, driven by core business performance. Simultaneously, losses within the company's electric vehicle segment narrowed compared to previous quarters. Retail investors holding the stock should note the balance between top-line expansion and ongoing segment profitability challenges.
why_it_matters: Revenue surge offsets EV losses for Greaves Cotton shareholders.
winners_losers: Greaves Cotton holders watch EV segment turnaround

headline: Greaves Cotton posts Q2 net profit down 81% to Rs 5 crore on exceptional expenses
hook: Sharp profit drop despite strong revenue growth
summary: Greaves Cotton reported a September-quarter revenue of Rs 1,176 crore, marking a 44 percent year-on-year increase. EBITDA also rose 41 percent during the quarter. However, net profit plunged 81 percent to Rs 5 crore due to exceptional expenses totaling Rs 32.75 crore. Indian retail investors tracking the engineering and mobility sector should note how exceptional costs can weigh heavily on headline profitability despite top-line expansion.
why_it_matters: Exceptional expenses compress bottom line despite revenue growth.

headline: Ampere launches Reo electric scooter at ₹71,999
hook: New budget EV option enters market
summary: Greaves Electric Mobility has launched the Ampere Reo electric scooter priced at ₹71,999. The vehicle features a claimed range of 80 km on a single charge and includes a portable battery. Additional specifications include keyless start and reverse assist functionality. This launch expands the company's presence in the entry-level electric two-wheeler segment.
why_it_matters: Increased competition in the affordable EV segment for Greaves Cotton.
winners_losers: Greaves Cotton gains / ICE scooter makers hurt

headline: Greaves Finance appoints Mukul Kanchan as Executive Director and CEO
summary: Greaves Cotton announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Greaves Finance Limited, has appointed Mukul Kanchan as Executive Director and CEO. The new leadership aims to scale up the company's electric vehicle financing business. Greaves Cotton informed the stock exchange regarding this press release issued on October 13, 2026. Retail investors in Greaves Cotton can track how EV financing growth impacts the subsidiary's contribution to consolidated revenues.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary leadership change aims to scale EV financing business.

headline: Greaves Electric Mobility opens 50 new experience centers
hook: Ampere doubles retail footprint across India
summary: Greaves Cotton subsidiary, Greaves Electric Mobility, has launched over 50 new experience centers for its Ampere brand. This expansion doubles the company's sales and service network across India within a 12-month period. The move aims to increase market penetration for its electric two-wheeler portfolio. Retail investors should note this as a potential indicator of scaling efforts in the competitive EV segment.
why_it_matters: Network expansion may boost long-term EV sales volume and revenue.
winners_losers: Greaves Cotton gains / Competitors face increased pressure

headline: Ampere launches Nexus EX+ electric scooter at ₹1.29 lakh
hook: New electric scooter targets mass market segment
summary: Greaves Electric Mobility has launched the Ampere Nexus EX+ electric scooter priced at ₹1.29 lakh. The vehicle features a 5kW motor, a claimed range of 136 km, and a battery life rated for 2 lakh kilometers. It includes over 30 connected features and offers faster charging capabilities. This launch expands the company's portfolio in the competitive Indian electric two-wheeler market.
why_it_matters: Increased competition in the electric two-wheeler space benefits consumers.
winners_losers: Greaves Cotton gains / incumbent EV makers face competition
